about: Test-only RSA keys (OpenSSL 3.6.3 genpkey for the usual sizes and public exponents; a small script for moduli of 8k+1 bits, which OpenSSL does not produce) and known-answer signatures made with plain big-integer arithmetic and hashlib (RFC 8017 EMSA-PKCS1-v1_5 and EMSA-PSS) over the stated message; PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey DER in hex. Never use these keys for anything.
